crashRecovery.title: Recover unsaved documents
crashRecovery.description: TextEx found editor snapshots that differ from the files on disk. Recovering opens them as unsaved changes and never overwrites disk automatically.
crashRecovery.hint: Compare the recovered text with the current disk version, then recover it into the editor or discard the snapshot.
crashRecovery.diskUnavailable: The disk version is missing or could not be read.
crashRecovery.replaceDirty: {{name}} now has other unsaved changes. Replace them with the recovered text?
crashRecovery.discardConfirm: Permanently discard the recovery snapshot for {{name}}?
crashRecovery.applyFailed: The recovered text could not be applied to the editor.

ai.title: AI Assistant
ai.description: Generate LaTeX from notes, fix grammar, rewrite academically, and paraphrase text. Bring your own API key from any supported provider.
ai.providerDesc: Choose which AI service to use for text generation.
ai.modelDesc: Pick a suggested model or enter any custom model ID. Leave it empty to use the recommended default.
ai.checkFailed: Couldn't verify whether an API key is already saved.
ai.saveFailed: Failed to save API key. Try again.
ai.apiKeyDesc: Enter your {{provider}} API key. Keys are stored locally and never shared.
ai.thinkingDesc: Enable extended thinking for deeper reasoning. Supported on Gemini 2.5/3, Claude Sonnet/Opus, and OpenAI o-series or GPT-5 models.
ai.enableThinkingDesc: Let the model reason step-by-step before answering
ai.customPromptsDesc: Customize the system prompts used for each AI action. Leave empty to use the built-in defaults.
ai.cliStatusDesc: Uses {{provider}} for AI features. No API key needed — uses your existing CLI login.
ai.cliNotFound: {{provider}} not found. Install it and ensure it is in your PATH.

integrations.zoteroDesc: Connect to Zotero to search and insert citations directly into your LaTeX documents. Requires Better BibTeX for Zotero installed.

automation.languageServerDesc: Enable advanced features like autocompletion and diagnostics
automation.offlineCacheDesc: Inspect the packaged Tectonic seed and the writable support-file cache.
